ruleDefinitions.name: Php Inline Command Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects execution of php using the "-r" flag. This is could be used as a way to launch a reverse shell or execute live php code.

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\php\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "php\.exe") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-r.*"))
